title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is just about to start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, just before the race, Daiwa Scarlet learns that Vodka is dropping out due to health concerns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She resolves to put on such an impressive performance that the crowd will forget Vodka ever existed.
